purpose: Additive corrective control chain for the attempt_001 whole-substring report-lexer false positive; no old artifact is changed and no scientific contract is broadened.

corrective_delta.only_scientific_or_report_functional_cha: Replace report substring membership with explicit whole-token and whole-phrase lexical matching; all parsed inputs, support, alignments, metrics, tables, and figures still execute directly from the sealed attempt_001 runner.
corrective_delta.additive_control_plane_changes: Adopt terminal FAIL attempt_001, govern one fresh attempt_002 with a new authority, and harden terminal publication against partial-final and return-code divergence faults.
corrective_delta.tokenization: lowercase maximal ASCII alphanumeric tokens; underscore, hyphen, whitespace, and punctuation are separators; matching never searches inside a token
corrective_delta.actual_rendered_report_gate: The exact analysis-report, stats-appendix, and figure-catalog templates rendered with synthetic metrics must pass before lock.

inherited_scientific_contract.normative_source: attempt_001 protocol and its exact 31 pinned scientific/runtime files
inherited_scientific_contract.rpe_pair_rule: row i to i+10, camera-row difference 20, timestamp difference exactly 1000000000 ns
inherited_scientific_contract.frame_contract: world_T_body estimates and official world_T_body GT; GT and IMU T_BS identity; no camera extrinsic
inherited_scientific_contract.primary_alignment: independent proper fixed-scale SE(3) per system on the identical 1358 points
inherited_scientific_contract.secondary_alignment: independent proper positive-scale Sim(3) diagnostic on the identical points; cannot replace primary

semantic_disclosure_inherited.hfnet_semantics: final-map reconstructed largest-map trajectory with lost frames skipped

attempt_002_lifecycle.root_creation: O_EXCL-equivalent os.mkdir; ownership recorded immediately after mkdir and before parent fsync
attempt_002_lifecycle.terminal_result_creation: Create hidden same-directory staging with O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_EXCL mode0600; capture dev/inode immediately and keep that fd open through rename and the first bound final audit; embed that ownership token in the canonical terminal JSON; write completely; fchmod0444; file fsync; re-fstat the held fd; exact nofollow content/seal/path-to-held-inode audit; atomically publish with Linux renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE); require one path-bound nofollow final read to report that same dev/inode, regular nlink1, exact embedded token, and staging absent; terminal-last.
attempt_002_lifecycle.terminal_semantic_commit_point: The exact sealed final is read and path-bound through one nofollow descriptor audit, its dev/inode equals the O_EXCL-opened staging ownership token, nlink is one, and the staging pathname is absent.
attempt_002_lifecycle.terminal_parent_directory_durability: After the semantic commit point, attempt parent-directory fsync three times. The stdout terminal_commit_audit records confirmed or unconfirmed when stdout is writable. Persistent fsync failure cannot invert the already committed JSON return_code; the terminal JSON explicitly makes no claim of parent-directory crash durability.
attempt_002_lifecycle.terminal_publish_after_success_exception: A structured rename-success marker is set only after terminal_publish_noreplace returns. Reconcile a later post-publish exception only when that marker is set, renameat2 removed staging, and one bound nofollow final read proves exact bytes/mode/nlink plus the original held staging dev/inode. EEXIST/ENOENT and same-byte foreign or hardlink paths never set the marker and are not reconciled.
attempt_002_lifecycle.terminal_transient_diagnostic_and_cleanu: Before semantic commit, final ownership/content audits and staging cleanup retry at most three times. An exception reclaims all uncommitted final/staging names by lstat and nofollow unlink inside the owned attempt, then atomically writes formal FAIL. After the first owned exact final audit, TERMINAL_COMMITTED and JSON return_code are cached; all later directory durability, audit, embedded-token, and foreign-staging cleanup work is best-effort and cannot invert the committed return code.
attempt_002_lifecycle.post_terminal_finalizers: Held snapshot close and signal-handler restoration are individually BaseException-safe. Their diagnostic failures are emitted after the terminal when stdout is writable and can never override either a committed PASS rc0 or committed FAIL rc1.
attempt_002_lifecycle.terminal_adoption_gate: A terminal is admissible only when its embedded dev/inode token matches the same path-bound nofollow read, JSON return_code equals the observed controller process return code, and controller stdout reports semantic_commit_point_reached, owned_final_inode_match, staging absence, post-commit observation state, and directory durability state. Active malicious same-UID namespace races remain outside the cooperative execution threat model, but tested same-byte EEXIST, hardlink EEXIST, and staging replacement all fail closed.

test_contract.atomic_terminal_fault_negatives_required: partial body write, post-fchmod, post-file-fsync, confirmed-rename-success then post-publish exception, exact-same-byte foreign EEXIST, hardlink EEXIST with staging present or removed, exact-same-byte staging replacement while original fd remains held, transient and persistent post-commit audit, post-commit diagnostic exception, post-commit foreign staging cleanup, transient precommit cleanup unlink, PASS and FAIL post-terminal finalizer exceptions, no-replace collision, transient and persistent parent-directory fsync

failure_closeout.post_semantic_commit_exception_rule: The cached owned PASS or FAIL terminal is the only outcome; no second terminal is created and process return_code remains the cached JSON return_code.
failure_closeout.commit_assignment_order: Cache committed JSON return_code and status first, then set TERMINAL_COMMITTED as the final non-fallible governance assignment before best-effort diagnostics.
failure_closeout.pending_signal_boundary: run_once performs its last raise_if_pending immediately before entering the non-interrupting atomic-publisher critical section. The installed handler only records while that section is active; a signal recorded after rename, whether before or after the owned semantic-commit assignment, cannot invert the terminal outcome.

claim_boundary.allowed: Artifact-level exact-common-tail descriptive values only, conditional on the two pinned artifacts and their non-equivalent output semantics.
claim_boundary.forbidden: Any winner, superiority, difference, ratio, percentage improvement, inferential, initialization-equivalence, V2_01, underwater, or generalization claim.
